title: My opinion on Pro Bodybuilding
summary: Part 1 of a series on pro bodybuilding. NH explains his background (a French manga fan, not an Arnold kid), why he respects pro bodybuilders as a separate, kamikaze top-tier sport, and why he targets fake natties on YouTube Fitness instead. He also argues natural bodybuilding was robbed of its potential and can never compete with the pros as a spectacle.
claims: If you do bodybuilding you are grouped with pro bodybuilders and live in their shadow, so he wants to explain his position
He did not grow up with Arnold; his heroes were anime and manga characters, and he only saw pro bodybuilders in his early 20s through YouTube Fitness
The moment he saw pro bodybuilders he knew they were not natural, so he never went through the disillusion many young men do
He only watches the highest level of any sport (NBA, World Cup quarter-finals onward), which is why he watches pro bodybuilding
Because his idols were fictional and never aged or sold supplements, he never became an emotionally attached fanboy
His channel would not exist without anime and manga
Pro and natural bodybuilding are as different as pro wrestling and wrestling: different goals, abilities and stages
Every pro bodybuilder is enhanced; believing otherwise is naive
Seeing pro bodybuilding as the next stage after natural bodybuilding is dangerous because it pushes young naturals toward drugs
He distinguishes the pro whose whole life is bodybuilding, who mostly hurts himself, from the YouTuber who juices to sell programs or supplements and hurts others
Pros do not really encourage PED use because a 270 lb, 5 percent body fat physique is too extreme for the average person to want
Anyone who thinks a pro physique is naturally attainable is either an idiot or very young
Pro training is no model for naturals; many pros skip compounds, use only machines and do not really understand training because they do not need to
Pro priorities are drugs, diet, recovery, then training; natural priorities are training, recovery, nutrition, then supplements, which are not very useful
The belief that pros know the most because they are biggest is a misconception; their size comes from the drugs
Pros claim to work harder than anyone to justify their size and satisfy sponsors, because the sport itself barely pays
Some pros historically resorted to prostitution to make money; pro bodybuilding is a dark world
YouTube Fitness is a visual game: the biggest, most jacked physique gets the clicks regardless of advice quality
Pros got into the sport from passion and sacrifice everything, even their lives, which earns his respect; fake natties started cycles knowing it would market their products
Fake natties are his target because they are killing YouTube Fitness and hurting people, not pro bodybuilders
Pro bodybuilding is a fringe, dying sport, so pros reach few people while fake natties reach the mainstream
Pros still bear some blame for bringing PED physiques into the mainstream
He is very anti-drugs but thinks adults can damage their own health if they want; he has no pity when they complain about the consequences
PED use becomes his problem when it is used to sell products to naive young audiences
Natural potential is not infinite or equal to enhanced; 270 lb at 5 percent body fat is impossible naturally, otherwise nobody would take PEDs
Natural bodybuilding needs its own standards and icons rather than sharing them with pro bodybuilding
Pros are like circus freaks, showing the body with health disregarded; it has a kamikaze beauty he respects
Competition drives people to do whatever it takes to win, which is why drugs took over bodybuilding; pros who say they took little are lying
Natural bodybuilding will never have a rebirth as a spectacle: on stage he would be about 200-205 lb at 12-13 percent, and audiences prefer a shorter pro 60-70 lb heavier and leaner
Pro bodybuilding peaked in the 70s and 80s because physiques were freaky but still relatable; today they are past that
Doing natural bodybuilding to get famous is as impure as taking PEDs, and it will not work
Bodybuilding, superhero movies and anime all feed the male power fantasy: projection as an emulation tactic
Naturals should seek other role models, yet natural channels, himself included, use enhanced physiques like Dorian Yates in thumbnails
Pros remain motivating as the pinnacle of human potential; he has Ronnie Coleman clips in his training playlist and skipped the Olympia on purpose
